bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 5, 6, 8, 9. LORAX performed well above market place expectations first up on the Randwick course proper and he can be expected to relish the switch to midweek competition here second up. SAVAGRAM trialed twice in July in preparation for his first up attempt today and this class should be ideal at his first run in a race. CANTERO is another debutant who must be respected. He's trialed twice since a spell and unlike some, he can cope over this journey at his first attempt. THREADS presents second up with winkers replacing blinkers. He wasn't disgraced on the Kensington track last start and stepping up slightly in distance now aids his cause.

raceTips.comment: Lorax hit the line strongly on debut over 1100m last start and would have taken considerable improvement off that performance, maps to get a soft run stalking the speed and saved for one sprint at them late out to the suitable 1200m. Threads would have taken significant improvement off the fresh performance last start, maps to enjoy the run of the race stalking the leading pair throughout with the in form jockey on board. Expecting competitive debut performances from Savagram & Cantero coming off solid trials leading in over the suitable 1200m.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 4, 8. CALOOCAN BEAUTY was spelled after a post-race issue was detected at Randwick back in January in a race that's produced strong form. She resumes today after trialing twice and she is suitably placed in this class. WANDA'S SPARK was too good for all except the winner when she made her debut last start on the Kensington track. Natural improvement can be expected here at start number two! SING YOUR SONG performed above market place expectations at her lone start in her first campaign. She resumes today after trialing twice with James McDonald aboard on both occasions and this race is within her reach. AFFARI must be forgiven for finishing unplaced when there were excuses at Eagle Farm on Anzac Day. She's also trailed twice recently and she must not be underestimated here.

raceTips.comment: Very keen on the Michael Freedman trained Wanda's Spark second up after hitting the line well on debut over 1100m, the filly would have taken considerable improvement off that performance and maps to enjoy a soft run throughout. The Chris Waller trained Sing Your Song is well placed resuming off a solid trial leading in, maps well and the 1200m is ideal. Expecting competitive first up performances from Caloocan Beauty & Affari off solid trials leading in with in form jockeys on board both gallopers.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 10, 12 13, 14. SISTER DAAE refused to shirk her task in defeat here last Wednesday when she was produced after a three week break. This much quicker back-up can now be regarded as a plus. CHEVAL DE BOIS stepped up into this distance range at Rosehill last start when his effort was full of merit. He can only now present race-fitter. KUMBAYA kept trying in defeat in a race that wasn't run to suit her here last Wednesday. She should greatly appreciate this step up from 1550m today. EMBALLEE is another who should be suited by the distance rise that awaits her here. Forgive an unplaced effort when she was last produced on the Kensington track. She can make a mockery of that effort here!

raceTips.comment: Cheval De Bois has shown enough ability to be competitive here and looks suited getting a chance to settle just off the speed. Cheval De Bois should appreciate having room to build momentum and will be strong late if the tempo is genuine. Sister Daae has been racing consistently and looks capable of settling in a handy position from the draw. Sister Daae has the tactical speed to keep herself within striking distance before producing her effort in the straight. Kumbaya has shown glimpses of ability and looks one that can improve with the right run in transit. Kumbaya should be suited by a genuine tempo and can finish off strongly. Equinox Legend has enough upside to be included in the wider chances. Equinox Legend needs to find a touch but can feature with the right breaks.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 7, 9, 10, 12. WRITTEN SCANDAL found the line strongly to score second up at Wyong before she didn't threaten here last start. She drops in class on her latest effort today and she is capable of regaining her best form today. KWIRKY SMILE stuck to her task after she became unsuited in transit third up at Rosehill and she will have scope to improve when she now makes her Canterbury debut. KAKADU SUNSET is resuming after two home based Randwick trials in July. Blinkers replace winkers today and this journey should be ideal first up. OAKFIELD NEPTUNE and TIGRONI are others who must be regarded as obvious winning chances in an even contest!

raceTips.comment: Tigroni looks well placed on the figures and has the ability to take control of the race from an advantageous position. Tigroni should be able to settle close enough to the leaders and get every chance when the pressure goes on. Written Scandal has enough speed to put herself into the race early and should be given every opportunity from the draw. Written Scandal needs to be strong through the final stages to threaten the main chances. Oakfield Naeptune has been competitive without winning and looks capable of running another honest race. Oakfield Naeptune will need to produce a sustained finish.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 4, 5, 8, 13. CAPTURE ME overcame problems when he scored with authority third up on the Illawarra Grange track last start and he should have more to offer when he now makes a Canterbury debut. UNSTOPABULL has been in work for some time but he did do more than enough here in this class last start to be treated with respect again today. RIVENDELL presents first up, making a Canterbury debut. He's proven first up and he's ready to fire after winning the second of his two lead-up trials late last month at his Randwick home base. MONTE VEEBEE resumes after a stable change and after winning the second of his two lead-up trials. He was dominant over this distance first up last preparation at Newcastle and this race is also within his reach.

raceTips.comment: Capture Me has the right profile for this contest and looks capable of settling closer to the speed than some of the main dangers. Capture Me has shown enough finishing ability to be prominent if the leaders are pressured throughout. Unstopabull has been racing in solid fashion and should appreciate a race where there is genuine pressure from the outset. Unstopabull can travel comfortably before being produced for one sustained run late. Royal Air Force has enough natural speed to put himself into a good position and should not be underestimated. Condone has shown ability but needs to lift his finishing effort against these rivals. Condone can still figure in the placings with the right run.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 4, 5, 7. MISS TRENTINO presents first up, attempting to extend her winning sequence to four. She finished unplaced when she resumed from her last spell at Wyong but there were excuses on that day in a race that produced strong form. INOUE was dominant when he was produced here first up and he should have more to offer over the same distance today, second up. ZALE was too good for all except INOUE here last start and he can maintain his form today without causing a surprise. SIR FRANKLIN resumes without a lead-up trial. He had the form behind him to figure in the finish today but without a lead-up trial behind him, be guided b y market moves for him after he parades?

raceTips.comment: Inoue was a dominant winner when resuming over 1100m last start and would have taken further improvement off that run, maps to get a soft run stalking the leading pair with James McDonald booked to ride.Zale continues to race well this preparation and is now ready to peak, has the superior early speed to find the front and dictate the tempo to suit. Expecting competitive first up performances from Miss Trentino & Sir Franklin over the suitable 1100m with in form jockey on board both gallopers.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 10, 11. BARKING MAD was attempting to notch a hat-trick when his Rosehill effort was more than solid after a twenty-four day break. He is suitably placed today within the same distance range when he presents after a quicker back-up. JOHN DORY became unsuited in transit at his Rosehill home base last start. He's proven here over this distance and he should be treated with great respect with Nash Rawiller now aboard for a first time. ANTHRACITE did a good job to finish as close to the winner as he did after he struck trouble when he was resuming on the Kensington track. He can only now present race-fitter and he's proven second up. FORECASTER performed above market place expectations on the Kensington track last start and he can maintain his form today without causing a surprise.

raceTips.comment: Barking Mad has been building a solid body of form and looks capable of settling prominently before producing his best late. Barking Mad has enough tactical speed to make his own luck and should be suited by a genuine tempo. There is an in-form jockey on board Barking Mad, which adds confidence to the selection. Forecaster has been competitive in similar company and should be able to find a comfortable position from the early stages. Forecaster can conserve energy in the run and looks capable of finishing strongly when the gaps appear.Three Arrows is another capable of finishing into the placings.
